summary: Create or reuse namespace object through emitted IIFE pattern.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: exists
tests.input: namespace N { export const x=1 }; console.log(typeof N,N.x);

tests.name: same object
tests.input: namespace N { export const a=1 }; const r=N; namespace N { export const b=2 }; console.log(r===N);
